current.text: Sean Sweeney is the new head coach. He replaces Jamahl Mosley.
Player roles may change under the new coach.
The projected starters are Jalen Suggs, Desmond Bane, Franz Wagner, Paolo Banchero and Wendell Carter Jr.
This starting five was very good when it played together.
Wendell Carter Jr. is the starting center. Nikola Vucevic is his backup.
Vucevic came back to Orlando on a minimum deal as a backup.
Goga Bitadze will still get some minutes at center, so the backup center minutes are split.
The bench was weak in scoring. Vucevic was added to fix that.
The team is 2.5 million USD under the second apron.
Because of the apron, Orlando will likely have to choose between keeping Jalen Suggs and keeping Anthony Black.
The expert predicts 47 or 48 wins and the 6th seed, avoiding the play-in. That is above the market win total of 43.5.
Orlando has 11 games in our fantasy playoff weeks, rank 4 of 30. Weeks 20 and 21 have 4 games each. Week 19 has only 3 games, including one back-to-back.

note: Orlando's projected starting five of Suggs, Bane, Wagner, Banchero and Carter should keep steady roles on a team expected to win. Its 11 games in our playoff weeks help all of them. Vucevic is only a backup center and shares the bench minutes with Bitadze, so he loses value. Black's future depends on the apron choice between him and Suggs. Early on, watch how the new coach Sean Sweeney spreads minutes and touches.
